subject.title: feat(ui): editable file panel with CodeMirror and sessions.files.set hash-CAS writes

question: Which implementation should own the permanent session-file editing API and Control UI path?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95956 add overlapping durable Gateway and UI contracts with materially different scope, dependencies, proof, and mutation semantics.

options.title: Combine Narrowly
options.body: Select one branch as the base and port only the strongest security, UX, and proof pieces from the other into one canonical contract.

options.title: Sponsor This Design
options.body: Keep the CodeMirror and hash-CAS approach after repairing atomicity, Markdown routing, and real-Gateway proof.

options.title: Adopt Earlier PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95956 if its broader preview scope is preferred, then close this competing branch.

recommendation.title: Combine Narrowly
recommendation.body: Select one branch as the base and port only the strongest security, UX, and proof pieces from the other into one canonical contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsored and landed the predecessor viewer and opened the focused feature issue governing this contract.
